hero.sub: From precast walls to precision drainage, Galana Group engineers every concrete solution with accuracy, speed, and a commitment that goes beyond supply.

services.name: Precast Concrete Products
services.desc: Pipes, wall panels, roof tiles, paving blocks, drainage systems and 40+ custom elements — manufactured to KEBS standards with precision vibration technology.

services.name: Custom Design & Engineering
services.desc: Our engineers work with architects and developers to design bespoke precast elements — beyond catalogue products. Submit your drawings, we manufacture to spec.

services.name: Site Assessment & Consultation
services.desc: We send qualified technicians to your site to assess drainage needs, recommend pipe sizes, calculate quantities and advise on the right products — free for qualifying projects.

services.name: Tracked Delivery & Logistics
services.desc: Real-time order tracking with WhatsApp & SMS notifications. Construction timelines are tight — we respect yours. Available across Kenya and East Africa.

services.name: Contractor & Bulk Accounts
services.desc: Dedicated portal for developers, county governments and NGOs. Access order history, invoices, preferred pricing and priority stock allocation in one dashboard.

services.name: Installation Referral Network
services.desc: Need laying or installation help? We connect you to our vetted contractor network — certified professionals who work with our products daily.

items.title: Instant Pricing Estimates
items.body: Unlike competitors, we give you indicative price ranges and quantity estimates online — no waiting days for a quote just to budget.

items.title: Real-Time Delivery Tracking
items.body: Every order dispatched is trackable. Receive WhatsApp + SMS alerts at dispatch, en route, and at delivery. Zero surprises.

items.title: East African Reach
items.body: Supply and logistics across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and beyond — with one point of contact and consistent quality standards.

items.title: KEBS & Standards Certified
items.body: Every product manufactured in compliance with Kenya Bureau of Standards. Documentation provided with every order for project records.

items.title: Sustainability Reporting
items.body: We provide carbon footprint data, recycled content percentages and water management benefits for green building certifications.

careers.heading: Build Your Career With Us
careers.sub: We're growing. We're ambitious. And we invest in people who share our drive to deliver extraordinary things.

faq.answer: We dispatch across Kenya and can coordinate East Africa deliveries. Typical lead times depend on product and plant load — share your site location in a quote request for a concrete timeline.
Our catalogue products are manufactured with KEBS-aligned quality processes. Project documentation can be provided with your order for records.
Drainage quantities depend on run length, joint type, and fall. Use the drainage calculator for sections, then our engineers can validate networks on site.
Paving estimates use m² × blocks per m² plus a wastage buffer for cuts. Patterns and edge restraints may add margin — the calculator is a solid first pass.
Roof tile counts exclude ridge and special pieces by default. Add a note in your quote if you need ridges, starters, or accessories.
Indicative pricing is confirmed per project. Use “Request quote” with your calculator + cart — we respond with formal pricing.
See contact details on this page for hours and channels. WhatsApp is fastest for quick questions.
